lyrics_set.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Verse]
Walking through the silver frost
Counting every breath I lost
Shadows stretch across the snow
Waiting for the world to grow
[Chorus]
Spring is waking in the trees
Carried on a sudden breeze
Colors bloom like hidden fire
Lifting every heart's desire
[Verse]
Ice is melting on the lake
Promises are left to wake
Golden light begins to spill
Over every valley, hill
[Chorus]
Spring is waking in the trees
Carried on a sudden breeze
Colors bloom like hidden fire
Lifting every heart's desire
[Bridge]
From the winter's long repose
To the beauty that unfolds
[Chorus]
Spring is waking in the trees
Carried on a sudden breeze
Colors bloom like hidden fire
Lifting every heart's desire
[Outro]
